name: lookup
description: Operator-driven investigation of a domain or IP address from the dashboard: DNS records via dig, registration and ownership via whois, and a plain-language reading of what the answer means. Answers the first question anyone asks about a flagged domain — what is this? — without leaving the product for a terminal. Read-only: it queries from the appliance and tasks no remote machine, so it sits on the safe side of the diagnostics access-control boundary. Results are tiered: beginner gets an interpretation and a next step, pro gets the raw dig/whois output.
